trailhead.label: The start of path 18 at Cella (Villapiccola), just above the chapel of Santa Caterina d’Alessandria, the board’s start

cautions: Grass and earth tracks that can be muddy after rain: take care on the way down.
Old hay barns and their meadows: keep your dog on the path and close.
Forest tracks open to forestry vehicles in places: keep your dog close if one comes.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Grass and earth tracks that can be muddy: Strade forestali erbose e in terra che dopo la pioggia possono essere fangose: attenzione in discesa.
textIt.Old hay barns and their meadows: keep yo: Vecchi fienili e i loro prati: tenete il cane sul sentiero e vicino a voi.
textIt.Forest tracks open to forestry vehicles: Strade forestali aperte in alcuni tratti ai mezzi forestali: tenete il cane vicino se ne arriva uno.
